messages:
harper_cs: Heads-up — BrightMetric wants to accelerate their renewal and move from monthly to annual prepay with a blended seat consolidation. They're proposing a 14-month effective term (12 paid + 2 months free) and a one-time onboarding workshop. Current ARR $135k. Procurement requires PO + signed DPA before finance will process. Need legal + finance + enablement to triage.

noel_sales: Buyer asked for a 9% blended concession if we agree to the 14-month structure and include the workshop. Leadership will approve up to 7% without exec review. I shared the deal summary with Irene.

irene_legal: I'll draft an amendment + DPA attachment. If Sales pushes past 7% we need VP Sales okay and a pricing guardrail. Also want to confirm SSO/SAML and KMS bits for data residency. ETA EOD.

matt_fin: Finance: vendor code BM-308 required. We prefer Net30 and PO. Prepay accepted if PO references BM-308. Note: two free months should be handled as service credit / revenue deferral. If discount >7% need VP Finance sign-off.

zoe_enable: Enablement can run the 90-min workshop and prepare a 30/60/90 success plan. Need 3 technical contacts + primary workloads to tailor content. We'll include a 3-question pulse after week 2 to capture onboarding satisfaction and reasons for accelerated renewal.

leo_se: SE notes: account health mostly green but we saw intermittent qps drops on gen endpoints last sprint. Recommend including a perf verification step in onboarding and enabling conservative batching during ramp. Adding runbook snippet:```batcher.max_latency_ms=20
cache.kv_prefix=true
monitor.alert.qps>900 => scale-up
```

harper_cs: Actions: @irene_legal draft amendment + DPA; @matt_fin confirm vendor code BM-308 and invoicing cadence; @noel_sales confirm final discount authority; @zoe_enable collect tech contacts; @leo_se add perf checklist.

irene_legal: Drafted amendment and uploaded: https://drive.company/contracts/brightmetric_amend_v1 — included SSO/KMS requirements, onboarding scope, and a pricing guardrail clause. If Commerce accepts 9% must get VP Sales approval noted in contract.

noel_sales: Quick update from buyer: CFO can accept 7% + the two free months. I'll confirm commercial summary and route for signature.

matt_fin: Vendor code BM-308 confirmed. PO route ok; we'll accept annual prepay if PO references BM-308. Finance will treat two free months as deferred revenue; I'll send ARR impact note to the thread.

contracts_bot: DocuSign envelope prepared -> https://docusign.company/brightmetric_xyz (signers: CFO, procurement lead). Fields prefilled: vendor code BM-308; billing cadence: annual prepay.

zoe_enable: I'll draft the invite template and the 3-question pulse now. Pulse includes: 1) What motivated the accelerated renewal? 2) How clear was onboarding scope? 3) Any immediate platform risks?

noel_sales: Sending DocuSign now. Adding @harper_cs as cc and setting notification to notify when signed.

harper_cs: Logged in Gainsight with tag "accelerated_renewal". Will escalate if signature not complete in 4 business days.

contracts_bot: DocuSign envelope status: completed at 6111112260. PO BM-308 received and matched. Invoice terms: annual prepay, Net30 for exceptions.

leo_se: Onboarding scheduled Apr 28 11:00 PT (90min). Perf checklist and runbook uploaded to the onboarding pack. I'll join the session and run the verification step.

zoe_enable: Enablement session confirmed. Pulse will be sent 2 weeks post-onboarding. I'll post results here.

harper_cs: Closing loop: contract executed, PO in, onboarding booked. Follow-up will include ARR impact from @matt_fin and the pulse results from @zoe_enable. Thanks everyone :tada:
